newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower in all months.

text.p: All Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Tuesday, as the market largely ignored the yen's gyrations against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were 0.4 to 1.4 yen per kg lower, with the most active June contract down 1.3 yen at 146.0 yen per kg.

The market was directionless in the morning despite the yen's swings against the dollar and this discouraged local investors, traders said. They added that sell orders emerged by late afternoon. The day's volume was 12,454 lots.
Open interest in the spot January contract, which expires next Monday, was 5,698 lots as of January 20.
